scope: Production file/recovery UI exercised through isolated headless Edge profiles and native IPC seams, not actual OS dialog/Hancom screen certification. Standalone XML and history IDB suites attest exact sources separately. HWT uses actual WASM and an explicit browser test bridge; history-ui also tests its actual production iframe facade and host menu. Optional native-cell/frame regressions require four explicit paths including their independent frame baseline; floating-host regressions require their three explicit paths and SHA-pinned source/oracle; native-prefix regressions require their pinned baseline and original Native file together; Python regressions require baseline, source HWPX and Native reference together. Absence adds no PASS or silent skipped case. Floating-host strict comparisons include stored metadata when both official engines expose it. The old native-row safety cases permit detected mismatch refusal; separate reflowed-native-storage/UI and native-prefix-storage/UI REQUIRE successful saves/reopens/follow-up edits. Computed-row-package independently checks ZIP authority. Agent suite includes actual approved-bound save and stale generation refusal.
